StepperNavigation

The `m3e-stepper` component — strict per-component surface.

import M3e
import M3e.Values
These helpers are our examples, not the library

The Doc.* helpers in these examples are this docs app's own module — not part of elm-m3e (they won't resolve from a fresh install). You rarely need anything like them. The library gives you typed components (M3e.*) plus TypedHtml for standard HTML, and you never import HtmlIr: M3e.Element, M3e.Attr, M3e.Node, M3e.Values.Value and M3e.Kind.Supported / .Shared are all re-exported, so every type annotation you need is reachable from the brand. Build layout, text, and links directly from those. The genuine escapes ship with the library too, in one greppable, lint-fenced place — M3e.Unsafe (fromHtml, fromNode, recast, and customElement for a custom tag the types can't express) and M3e.Unsafe.Attributes. See Escapes.

<form>
<m3e-form-field>

<div slot="actions">

</div>
</m3e-step-panel>
<m3e-step-panel id="step2">

API

Constructor

view : List.List (HtmlIr.Attribute.Attr M3e.Component.Stepper.Attrs msg) -> List.List (HtmlIr.Element.Element childAccepts (M3e.Component.Stepper.ChildAdmittedBy childAdm) msg) -> HtmlIr.Element.Element (M3e.Component.Stepper.Is s) admittedBy msg

Standard constructor: [attributes] [children].

type Is

The kind row m3e-stepper produces (open — composes into any slot naming it).

type Attrs

The closed attribute-capability row.

type Builder

The narrowed pipe-builder this component's M3e.Build.<X> module exposes.

type AttrCaps

The attribute capabilities this component's builder admits.

type SlotCaps

The singular-slot capabilities this component's builder admits.

type PanelSlot

The kinds the panel slot admits.

type StepSlot

The kinds the step slot admits.

type ChildAdmittedBy

The context demand this container injects into each child's admittedBy row.

type HeaderPosition

The headerPosition values valid on this component (compile-tight narrowing).

type LabelPosition

The labelPosition values valid on this component (compile-tight narrowing).

type Orientation

The orientation values valid on this component (compile-tight narrowing).

Other

headerPosition : HtmlIr.Value.Value M3e.Component.Stepper.HeaderPosition -> HtmlIr.Attribute.Attr { c | headerPosition : HtmlIr.Kind.Supported } msg

The position of the step header, when oriented horizontally. (default: "above")

labelPosition : HtmlIr.Value.Value M3e.Component.Stepper.LabelPosition -> HtmlIr.Attribute.Attr { c | labelPosition : HtmlIr.Kind.Supported } msg

The position of the step labels, when oriented horizontally. (default: "end")

orientation : HtmlIr.Value.Value M3e.Component.Stepper.Orientation -> HtmlIr.Attribute.Attr { c | orientation : HtmlIr.Kind.Supported } msg

The orientation of the stepper. (default: "horizontal")

linear : Basics.Bool -> HtmlIr.Attribute.Attr { c | linear : HtmlIr.Kind.Supported } msg

See M3e.Attributes.linear.

onChange : msg -> HtmlIr.Attribute.Attr { c | onChange : HtmlIr.Kind.Supported } msg

See M3e.Events.onChange.

onBeforeinput : msg -> HtmlIr.Attribute.Attr { c | onBeforeinput : HtmlIr.Kind.Supported } msg

See M3e.Events.onBeforeinput.

onInput : msg -> HtmlIr.Attribute.Attr { c | onInput : HtmlIr.Kind.Supported } msg

See M3e.Events.onInput.

panel : HtmlIr.Element.Element M3e.Component.Stepper.PanelSlot admittedBy msg -> HtmlIr.Element.Element free freeAdmittedBy msg

Place an element into the named panel slot (input constrained to the slot's kinds; output row free so it composes into the child list).

step : HtmlIr.Element.Element M3e.Component.Stepper.StepSlot admittedBy msg -> HtmlIr.Element.Element free freeAdmittedBy msg

Place an element into the named step slot (input constrained to the slot's kinds; output row free so it composes into the child list).
